summary: InferAll is an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible AI gateway. New accounts get 25 free NVIDIA NIM calls with no card. A one-time $5 activation (which becomes spendable balance, not a fee) then unlocks ongoing $0 input/output access to 10+ NIM open-source models — Nemotron, GLM 5.3 and other currently listed $0 models; consult the live model catalog — within free-plan daily caps of 50 chat / 100 text / 20 image-analyze / 10 image-generate / 5 video-generate requests per day. Catalog presence and zero listed prices are not a redeemed inference test.
claim_steps: Create an account and get an API key at inferall.ai/keys — no card for the first 25 NIM calls.
Check https://api.inferall.ai/ai/v1/models for currently listed $0 NIM model IDs, then call the OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible endpoint with one of those IDs.
To keep ongoing free NIM access after the 25-call trial, pay the one-time $5 activation; it becomes spendable balance for premium providers.
